annotations.text:
Stock Alerts — visual direction

Dark-mode-first: Public Sans + IBM Plex Mono (tickers), oklch blue-violet accent, calm/alert/muted status system for Active/Triggered/Disabled.

2026-09-13 update: redesigned alarm cards, an alarm filters bar, an admin users tab, the password-recovery flow, and (latest) a theme picker on Settings and an admin invite flow (invite modal + email-link account activation).

Assumption to confirm: "invite" = the admin only enters email + role; the invitee gets an emailed link to set their own password (reusing the password-reset token/mailer infra), rather than the admin choosing a password for them. Say if you'd rather the admin set an initial password directly instead.
